description: Delete an application together with all of its environments and their secrets, discarding the ciphertext. Irreversible — there is no undo and no export. This is the widest-blast-radius tool here; prefer delete_env for a single environment, or rename_app if the name is the only problem. Confirm intent with a human before calling. Returns { ok, app }.

app.description: Application slug or id, as returned by list_apps (e.g. "storefront").

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: delete_app
